description: Score and rank MCP tools by relevance to a task intent. Optionally prune low-relevance tools to save context tokens.

intent.description: The task description or user intent to score tools against

mode.description: rank: score and sort all tools. prune: also mark bottom-M tools for removal

prune_count.description: Number of lowest-scoring tools to prune (only in prune mode, default 5)

tools.description: Array of tool definitions to score

name: prune_tools
